before.name: Harry Sacher
before.description: Harry Sacher was a defense attorney at the 1949 Foley Square trial of the eleven Communist Party leaders. For his courtroom defense, Judge Harold Medina found him in contempt and sentenced him to prison; the Supreme Court upheld the contempt convictions of the lawyers in 1952 (Sacher v. United States), and he was also subjected to disbarment proceedings.

before.name: Louis McCabe
before.description: Louis McCabe was one of the five defense lawyers for the eleven Communist leaders tried at the 1949 Foley Square Smith Act trial, a landmark McCarthy-era prosecution. He was cited for contempt of court for his courtroom defense and given a 30-day sentence.
